newsitem.title: USA: BEFORE THE BELL - Lilco, Brooklyn Union rise.
newsitem.headline: BEFORE THE BELL - Lilco, Brooklyn Union rise.

text.p: The announced merger of New York utilities Long Island Lighting Co and Brooklyn Union Gas Co attracted investors to shares of both companies preceding Monday's U.S. market open.
Before the bell, Lilco share rose to 22 from 19-3/8 while Brooklyn Union added 3/8 to 31-1/2, traders said.
Sunday afternoon, the companies said they reached a definitive agreement to merge in a tax-free stock swap valued at $3 billion, or $25 a share for Lilco stock.

Shares in Nordstrom Inc fell to 34 from 37-1/2 before Monday's market open on the retailer's announcement Friday that it expects earnings for the quarter ending January 31 to be under Wall Street expectations.
Nordstrom blamed the shortfall partly on a decline in holiday same-store sales.
According to First Call, the analysts' consensus earningas expectation for the fourth quarter was $0.80 per share versus $0.67 one year ago.
Also, Goldman Sachs said it cut the stock to market perform from outperfrom abnd lowered earnings forecasts.
